verdicts.reason: Pilots in Ghana, Kenya and Malawi had reached about 1.5 million children by April 2023 (low single-digit share of the eligible cohort). Rollout widened from 2024; WHO now lists 25 African countries offering the vaccine (5 national, 19 subnational) targeting more than 10 million children a year, roughly a quarter of the region's birth cohort, but most below target scale for lack of funding. Mainstream, if at all, 3-5 years after 2022, not by 2024.

evidence.title: RTS,S - Wikipedia
evidence.shows: About 1.5 million children vaccinated in Ghana, Kenya, Malawi by April 2023; WHO recommended for broad use Oct 2021.

evidence.title: Q&A on malaria vaccines (WHO)
evidence.shows: 25 African countries offer malaria vaccines (5 national, 19 subnational); >10 million children a year targeted; most below national target scale.

verdicts.reading: Proof of stake becomes the consensus method of major blockchains, with Ethereum switching in 2022.
verdicts.mainstream_test: Event test plus routine use: Ethereum completes the switch in 2022, making proof of stake the method of the large majority of smart-contract blockchain activity (20% of the relevant industry) by 2024.
verdicts.reason: Ethereum completed the Merge to proof of stake on 15 September 2022, cutting its energy use by over 99%, as the edition said. With Ethereum, Cardano, Solana and Algorand all on proof of stake, it is the dominant consensus outside Bitcoin.

evidence.title: Ethereum - Wikipedia
evidence.shows: The Merge, 15 Sep 2022, moved Ethereum to proof of stake and cut energy use by over 99%.

verdicts.reading: An oral covid antiviral (Paxlovid) becomes a widely used treatment for covid patients, now in 2022.
verdicts.mainstream_test: 20% of target users (eligible high-risk covid outpatients in major markets) treated with the pill by 2024; 5% floor by 2022.
verdicts.reason: Throughout 2022 only 10-12% of eligible US adult outpatients received Paxlovid (above 5%, below 20%), held back by rebound worries, unfamiliarity and cost; in 2023 it had about 3 million US prescriptions and US$1.28bn revenue. No evidence that it reached 20% of eligible patients by 2024.

evidence.title: Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir - Wikipedia
evidence.shows: In 2022 only 10-12% of eligible US adult outpatients received it; >3 million US prescriptions in 2023; Pfizer revenue ~$1.28bn in 2023.

verdicts.reading: Synthetic data becomes a routine input for building AI models, now in 2022.
verdicts.mainstream_test: Routine use by 20% of the relevant industry (developers of AI models) by 2024.
verdicts.reason: Synthetic data became a core component of LLM post-training pipelines (Self-Instruct, Persona Hub and successors), used by the major model developers by 2023-24. No survey share was found; the call rests on the standard practice of the dominant AI developers. A narrower reading (a market of firms selling synthetic data) would be weaker.

evidence.title: Synthetic data - Wikipedia
evidence.shows: 'Synthetic data generation has become a core component of the post-training pipeline' for large language models.

verdicts.reading: Direct-air-capture carbon removal factories (Climeworks Orca and successors) remove CO2 at meaningful scale, now in 2022.
verdicts.mainstream_test: Routine use: DAC delivering 20% of durable carbon removal, or used routinely by 20% of the relevant industry (large emitters buying removals), by 2024; 5% floor by 2027.
verdicts.reason: Orca (2021) is rated at up to 4,000 t/yr and Mammoth (2024) up to 36,000 t/yr; a May 2025 investigation found they capture only a fraction of that and do not yet offset Climeworks' own emissions. Global DAC removal is thousands of tonnes per year against billions of tonnes of total carbon removal, far below 5%. Provisional: window closes 2027.

evidence.title: Climeworks - Wikipedia
evidence.shows: Orca 4,000 t/yr (2021), Mammoth 36,000 t/yr (2024) nominal; Heimildin May 2025: captures a fraction of capacity, not offsetting own emissions.

verdicts.reading: Driverless robotaxis are available to the public and in mainstream use in major markets around 2025.
verdicts.mainstream_test: 20% of target users (ride-hail trips in major markets: US, China) taken in robotaxis by 2027; 5% floor by 2025.
verdicts.reason: Waymo gives about 500,000 paid rides a week (March-June 2026) in 10 US metros; that is on the order of 1% of US ride-hail trips, and Baidu, Pony and others operate in a few Chinese cities. Below 5% of ride-hail trips in the US or China as a whole by 2025. City-level shares (e.g. San Francisco) may already exceed 5%, but no measure was found. Provisional: window closes 2030, and a hit by 2027 is still possible.

evidence.title: Waymo - Wikipedia
evidence.shows: About 500,000 paid rides per week (March and June 2026) across 10 US metro areas; no market-share figures.

evidence.title: Robotaxis (MIT TR10 2025)
evidence.shows: Framing: robotaxis now becoming available to the public; WHO Baidu, Pony AI, Waymo, Wayve, Zoox.
